data: At which of the following approximate threshold values do all the metrics have the same value?

The question asks for the approximate threshold value at which all three metrics (precision, recall, and F1-score) have the same value. From the analysis of the figure:

1. The lines representing precision, recall, and F1-score intersect at approximately the same point.
2. At this intersection point, the values of all three metrics appear to be equal.

By examining the graph, the intersection occurs around the threshold value of 0.5. Therefore, the approximate threshold value where all metrics have the same value is 0.5.
